title: Two people, one last slot
subtitle: An invented race — not a database implementation
intro: Both contenders see the same last available slot. The atomic claim, not the earlier availability display, decides who gets it.
ask: Can you follow what the winner and the other person each see?
afterwards: The agent will clarify unclear steps. No booking or database request is made.

items.title: Only the atomic claim reserves the last slot
items.body: Example person A and example person B both saw availability. Their claims are arbitrated atomically, with exactly one winner. This is the required behavior, not an implementation of transactions, isolation, locking or database constraints.

items.title: The other person gets a clear next step
items.body: The winner receives a confirmation. The other person is told the slot was taken and can choose another slot; they never receive a false confirmation. The illustration does not promise fairness about who wins.

diagrams.title: One atomic winner, two explicit outcomes
